method.source: Read actual Swift sources, implementation call sites, test assertions, and cached Arc anatomy; historical_status is provenance only. No Arc launched, no REA run, no cra checkout read or copied.
method.verification: Ran swift test locally: 459 tests, 3 existing skips, zero failures. Read and hash-matched all 520 entries of the parent CEF evidence manifest; all 45 parent scenarios passed. Ran isolated AppKit and domain probes under .build using StubEngine, not real CEF.
method.status_policy: verified is limited to the stated functional acceptance with matching unit and native proof. implemented means the described behavior has a source path but some required checks are missing. partial includes incomplete workflows or runtime wiring. Stored switches, menu rows and placeholders are not completion. No pixel-parity claim.
method.ownership_limit: Exactly 79 assigned IDs. Canonical inventory and audit unchanged. See native-shell.md for the same-tab multiwindow gap and preserved focus/privacy contracts.
method.reference_limit: Cached binary-derived constants and resource observations are distinguished from inferred interaction and measurement claims. No authenticated Arc UI reference on this host.
